methodology.period: Illustrative first 12 months from the start of active commercialization; not calendar 2026.
methodology.forecast_type: Conditional scenarios, not probability-weighted forecasts or observed results.
methodology.revenue_recognition: Service revenue after stated credits plus actual paid customer-months. End-of-period MRR is not full-year earned revenue.
methodology.cash_surplus: Revenue less modeled cash expenses, before founder pay, personal taxes, additional reinvestment, financing, working-capital timing, and any unmodeled expense.
methodology.economic_surplus: Cash surplus less all founder hours valued at an assumed $50/hour. Not a GAAP measure.
methodology.payment_fees: 3% is a rough assumed blended collection cost, not a quote for any processor; fixed transaction and subscription billing fees may increase it.
methodology.api_cost: $15 per paid business customer-month is an unverified planning allowance, not a measured average or named-provider quote.
methodology.support: 0.25 basic support hours per business-month plus 1.5 additional hours per managed-month. These are modeling assumptions, not approved public service commitments.
methodology.customer_counts: Service transactions may overlap across the same customer. Managed subscribers are a subset of software subscribers. Revenue ramps are net active accounts, not acquisition predictions.
methodology.availability: Paid software revenue requires working identity, entitlements, controlled API gateway, metering and a deliverable paid workflow. Delays reduce modeled customer-months.
methodology.hours: Includes estimated delivery, ongoing support, sales/admin/free fit calls and product development; paid contractor hours replace a subset of estimated labor rather than duplicating it.
